meta.description: Sellability Scorecard engine — SDE/EBITDA multiple valuation for AU trade businesses. Indicative only; based on published AU broker multi-range data (Miro Capital, Future Business Brokers, OneBookPlus, iaindarroch 2025-26).
meta.disclaimer: This is an indicative estimate, not a formal valuation. A professional valuer or broker sets final pricing.

questions.prompt: What trade is the business in?
Annual profit BEFORE tax, after your own wage? (Owner's Benefits / SDE-like)
How much revenue is recurring (service plans, maintenance contracts, retainers)?
Revenue trend over the last 2 years?
How strong is the digital footprint? (website, Google reviews, online presence)
How long could the business run WITHOUT you?

options.label: I do most of the work myself

questions.prompt: What share of revenue comes from your top 3 clients?

options.label: OK — up to date but basic

questions.prompt: When do you want to exit or sell?

bands.label: Acquisition-Ready
bands.blurb: Well set up to sell at a top multiple. Strong systems, low owner-dependence and clean books mean buyers can see the value.

bands.label: Improve to Sell Well
bands.blurb: Solid business, but fixing key gaps could lift your multiple by 0.5-1.0x — often worth $50K-$200K+ at sale time.

bands.label: Build Value First
bands.blurb: Most value is tied to you and your day-to-day. Prepare now and you set up a far stronger sale or succession later.

action_map.low_independence: Reduce owner-dependence: hire or promote a second-in-charge, document job processes, move yourself out of quoting and dispatching.
action_map.low_concentration: Diversify the client base — top-3 concentration over 60% scares buyers. Target new segments or territories.
action_map.low_recurring: Add service plans / maintenance agreements. Recurring revenue is the single strongest multiple lift available.
action_map.low_systems: Adopt proper job management software (ServiceM8, Tradify, Simpro) and document how the business runs day to day.
action_map.low_books: Get bookkeeping current and reconciled monthly. Clean books are what let a sale settle quickly (and at a better price).
action_map.low_digital: Build the digital footprint: website, Google Business Profile, review flow. Brand value beats reputation-in-head.
action_map.low_compliance: Get every licence current and WHS documented. Compliance gaps are the #1 reason deals stall in diligence.
action_map.low_growth: Show 12-24 months of pipeline and growth evidence — buyers pay more for momentum.
action_map.low_profit: Improve job-costing and pricing discipline — profit normalisation is where most sale value is created or lost.
